user.title: Set up Sendspin
user.description: Home Assistant will act as a Sendspin server so it can adopt and control Sendspin speakers on your network. It does not play audio itself and does not advertise itself over mDNS.

data_description.name: The name speakers see when Home Assistant connects to them.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Sendspin found on your network
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant found {name}. Setting Sendspin up lets you adopt and control Sendspin speakers. No speaker is adopted until you choose one — adopting takes a speaker away from whatever is currently using it.

data_description.name: The name speakers see when Home Assistant connects to them.

abort.not_sendspin: This device does not look like a Sendspin server or player.

user.title: Adopt a Sendspin speaker
user.description:
Adopting a speaker makes Home Assistant its Sendspin server. If Music Assistant or another Sendspin server is currently using it, that server will lose it, and it may take it straight back.

Found {discovered} speakers on your network. Pick one, or enter the address of a speaker that did not appear.

data_description.listener_url: Pick a discovered speaker, or type an address such as ws://192.168.1.50:8928/sendspin

error.invalid_url: That is not a valid Sendspin address. It should look like ws://192.168.1.50:8928/sendspin

adopt_player.name: Adopt speaker
adopt_player.description: Makes Home Assistant the Sendspin server for a speaker. If another Sendspin server is using it, that server will lose it, and it may take it straight back.

listener_url.name: Speaker address
listener_url.description: The speaker's Sendspin address, for example ws://192.168.1.50:8928/sendspin. The listener URL is used because it is the only identifier a speaker presents both while attached and while idle.

release_player.name: Release speaker
release_player.description: Stops holding a speaker so another Sendspin server, such as Music Assistant, can take it.

device_id.name: Speaker
device_id.description: The Sendspin speaker to act on.

reclaim_player.name: Reclaim speaker
reclaim_player.description: Takes a speaker back from whichever server currently holds it. Adoption stops competing when another server claims a speaker; this asks Home Assistant to try again.

device_id.name: Speaker
device_id.description: The Sendspin speaker to act on.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for the speaker to come back.

not_loaded.message: Sendspin is not set up, or failed to start.

invalid_url.message: {url} is not a valid Sendspin address. It should look like ws://192.168.1.50:8928/sendspin

not_a_sendspin_device.message: That device is not a Sendspin speaker.

never_seen.message: {url} has never connected, so there is nothing to reclaim yet.
